snippet.title: Fallen Tear Console Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the latest trailer for the hand-drawn, story-driven Metroidvania from CMD Studios and Maximum Entertainment.

Step into the world of Raoah as Hira, a mysterious child destined to stand against ancient gods. Explore a vast interconnected world, forge bonds with a diverse cast of allies, and battle your way through a kingdom on the brink of collapse.

Dynamic Combat — Slash, parry and dodge your way through Raoah's guardians, with deep skill trees and customizable loadouts.

Fated Bonds — Recruit up to 22 companions, each bringing unique abilities, stories and new ways to explore the world.

Build Your Home — Grow and customize the Temple of Oras between expeditions, unlocking upgrades and spending time with the allies you've gathered.

A Hand-Drawn World — Discover a beautifully animated fantasy world brought to life with hand-drawn visuals and professional voice acting.

Combining the emotional weight and party-building of a classic JRPG with the exploration of a Metroidvania and a touch of souls-like challenge, Fallen Tear: The Ascension offers a world where every bond can shape your journey.

Fallen Tear: The Ascension is available now on PC via Steam and comes to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027.
